preview.text: Australia Champions and Bangladesh Champions meet in a T20 match at Sharjah Cricket Stadium, where the usual first-innings score in the 82 recorded T20 matches is 153. Australia Champions won the toss and chose to bat first. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 36 degrees.

summary.text: Australia Champions won by 37 runs. AUSCH made 203-6, David Warner (c) top-scoring with 66 off 38 balls; Abu Jayed took 3 for 46. BANCH made 160-6, Mahmudullah (c) top-scoring with 67 off 33 balls; Fawad Ahmed took 2 for 31. Sides batting first at Sharjah Cricket Stadium usually make about 153.
